int_name: N FRONT ST & E TIOGA ST

result.summary: The street environment consists of a wide roadway with residential row houses and a signalized intersection that lacks dedicated pedestrian signals. Faded zebra crosswalks and parked vehicles near the corners reduce visibility and safety for people crossing. The absence of lane markings and the overall width of the street may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk is significantly worn, reducing its visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles are located very close to the intersection, blocking the view between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Curbside on both sides of the street near the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks dedicated walk/don't-walk signals for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and prevent parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-specific signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow urban street with mixed-use residential and commercial buildings and sidewalks on both sides. While a traffic signal is present, the environment lacks visible crosswalk markings, curb ramps, and pedestrian signals, which reduces safety and accessibility.

hazards.name: Faded/Absent Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The lack of visible crosswalk markings at a signalized intersection fails to designate a safe path for pedestrians and reduces driver awareness.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of sloped curb transitions creates a physical barrier for pedestrians with mobility aids or strollers.

interventions.description: Install continental-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.
